lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Co4O5 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a 22-atom unit cell (Li4 Co8 O10) distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Co and Li centers surrounded by six O neighbors each in octahedral motifs, while O centers have three to four geometric neighbors, mainly Co and Li. The resulting neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 22 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner-sharing between Co and Li octahedra, and both corner- and edge-sharing among Co octahedra.
